unsupportedField: The people import doesn't use this field. Remove it from the mapping.
medicalNotes: Medical notes are never imported. Remove this column from the mapping and add notes on the member's profile.
invalidDate: Enter a real past date, such as 2012-04-25.
ambiguousDate: This date could be day-first or month-first. Use the YYYY-MM-DD format.
invalidStatus: Use prospect, trial, active, frozen, cancelled, or visitor.
invalidBillingDay: Use a day of the month from 1 to 31.
invalidCustomer: Use a Stripe customer ID, which starts with cus_.
invalidPaymentMethod: Use a Stripe payment method ID, such as one starting with pm_.
duplicateInFile: This person also appears in row {row}.
familyMismatch: Rows in the same household have different values for this field.
ambiguousFamily: This family matches more than one existing household. Review the family links before importing.
usedByOtherFamily: Another household in this file uses the same ID.
customerInUse: This Stripe customer already belongs to another household.
customerConflict: This household already has a different Stripe customer.
paymentMethodInUse: This payment method already belongs to another household.
paymentMethodNeedsCustomer: A saved payment method needs the household's Stripe customer ID.
